transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for being here. We currently have a draft plan with eight stations, 15-minute sessions, unrestricted visitor recording, and a general accessibility notice. Please share any confirmed requirements or concerns from your areas so we can address them properly. Who would like to start?

I recorded these findings in the technical worksheet, though it hasn't been attached to the festival master brief yet.
